description: Change the Timeline selection: select given clips (Selection tool), every clip (Edit > Select All), none (Edit > Deselect All), the clips under the playhead (Select Clip at Playhead), every clip from a time on or before it (Track Select Forward and Backward tools), or the clip after or before each selected one on its track (Next and Previous in Sequence). Returns the selected clips. Not an undo step

clips.description: With mode clips: the clips to select (items from list_clips)

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

mode.description: clips: the given clips; all; none; at_playhead; forward: clips ending after time; backward: clips starting before time; next and previous: the neighbour of each selected clip on its track

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

time.description: With forward and backward: seconds. Default the playhead

track.description: Only clips on this kind of track (give with trackIndex); default every video and audio track

trackIndex.description: Only this track, 0 = V1 or A1 (with track)

name: select_clips
title: Select Clips
